name: Fred Baldwin
occupation: Physician assistant; theatre owner (2021–22 legislative directory)
education: Nursing studies at Casper College and the University of Wyoming; University of Utah School of Medicine (as listed in the 2021–22 legislative directory)
background: Fred Baldwin of Kemmerer served in the Wyoming House from 2015 to 2016 and in the Senate from 2017 to 2024, representing Senate District 14. The 2021–22 legislative directory said he was born Sept. 23, 1956, in Afton; listed nursing studies at Casper College and the University of Wyoming and the University of Utah School of Medicine; and identified him as a physician assistant and theatre owner. The same entry said he was married to his wife, Parry, and had five children and five grandchildren.
